title: feat: show cert status badges on dispatch board
body:
## Summary
Adds certification status badges to technician cards on the dispatch board. Queries the certifications DB directly to get expiration dates and computes the badge status.

## Test plan
- Manual testing with technicians who have valid, expiring, and expired certs
- Checked that badge shows worst status when multiple certs exist

commits.messageHeadline: feat: add cert status badge component
feat: query cert data and wire up to dispatch board
